Class DiscordGradientEffect

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.ConfigurableTextEffect
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.effects.DiscordGradientEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
IChromaticEffect
public class DiscordGradientEffect extends ConfigurableTextEffect
Paints a stationary horizontal gradient through the supplied palette.

The default span is 80 GUI pixels. Within each span, interpolation moves from the first palette entry toward the last, then starts again at the next span. This differs from a cyclic gradient that smoothly interpolates the final entry back to the first. Constructor speed arguments are accepted for factory compatibility and are not used.

Colors are packed RGB values; positions and offsets are in GUI pixels. Animated callbacks use the clock shared by the current draw and leave drawing to the renderer. Registrations share this object, so configure it before registering it and synchronize any later changes.

  • Constructor Details

    • DiscordGradientEffect

      public DiscordGradientEffect(float colorSpeed, float moveSpeed, List<Integer> colors)
      Creates a stationary gradient across the supplied palette.

      Use the movement factory to validate the palette, speeds and options: MovementRegistry.create. Direct construction skips that validation. The built-in factory supplies a copied, nonempty immutable list. Any palette entry read by the effect must be non-null; direct construction does not inspect the entries, so a null entry can fail later during rendering.

      Parameters:
      colorSpeed - unused; accepted to match the factory signature
      moveSpeed - unused factory-compatible argument; geometry remains stationary
      colors - non-null RGB list retained by reference; an empty list renders white

  • Method Details

    • getRenderColor

      public int getRenderColor(int original, float x, float y)
      Samples the stationary first-to-last palette gradient over the configured horizontal span. Chooses the color for the current glyph sample.

      The renderer can sample multiple corners to create a gradient. Return the input color when this effect should leave it unchanged. Supply transparency through IChromaticEffect.getOpacity(); alpha bits in the returned color are ignored.

      Parameters:
      original - incoming packed RGB; this implementation may replace it
      x - horizontal sample position in GUI pixels
      y - vertical sample position in GUI pixels
      Returns:
      packed RGB for this sample
